interpretation: PASS = chacha20 PRNG sufficient for AN11(c) sampling-style audits at n=1024 (JSD vs SV1 ideal QRNG below 0.01 threshold).
honest_c3: PRIMARY metric = per-qubit balance JSD (32-bin); 16-bit raw token JSD is sample-noise-dominated at n=1024
PRNG = secrets.randbits (kernel CSPRNG, ChaCha20-based on Linux/macOS getentropy(3))
SV1 |+>^16 with H gates = ideal uniform 16-bit distribution (noiseless simulator)
Threshold 0.01 chosen to be roughly 5x the per-qubit binomial-noise JSD floor at n=1024 (~0.0005)
